item.description: WINSTON-SALEM, N.C. item.title: Tax Conformity: Will SC taxpayers have to amend returns?
item.description: Early tax filers in South Carolina are sounding the alarm, questioning why the state legislature has failed to vote on whether it will conform to the new federal tax deductions.

item.title: Mauldin City Council approves $2 facility fee for new stadium
item.description: The Mauldin City Council unanimously approved a new facility fee Monday night that will be applied to tickets sold at the Bridgeway Station stadium.

item.title: As Greenville grows, firefighters warn of longer response times
item.description: Parker District Fire Department (PDFD) officials said Greenville’s recent growth and annexation plans could shrink the district’s service area and impact emergency response times.
